description: Get a quote for one action call. The quote pins the exact tool + args and returns a quote_id for confirm. Nothing that changes or costs anything executes until confirm. Quotes expire after 10 minutes. A plain read that list_actions marks "answers on quote" returns its result in this same call, with nothing to confirm.

agent_key.description: Optional agent key. Don't hunt for one first, and never ask your human to make one: quote without a key and, if the action needs one, the reply gives you the link your human opens to connect you — the key reaches you through this door.

args.description: Arguments for the action, matching its parameters schema (max 16KB).

connect.description: Optional. true asks for the link your human opens to connect you (and your agent key) without running anything. Use it when you have no key and need your human's own data from an action that also answers signed-out visitors.

name: quote
